findings.summary: [RESERVED-PATH REDIRECTED] Spec §3 evidence carrier is not delivered for this attempt: `.dd-evidence/attempt_01M04FM1BBF9S1HR5BB5AJ892A/h7-scope.md` does not exist in the reviewed tree (the `.dd-evidence` directory contains only acceptance.json from an unrelated development and the prior rejected attempt's unchanged file), so none of the three required echo categories — red-first, mutation, production-form — is committed into the reviewed tree for this delivery, violating spec §3 ('三类回显落 .dd-evidence/<attempt_id>/h7-scope.md，随交付提交进被审树') and §6 item 7.

[RESERVED-PATH REDIRECTED] Red-first evidence is still absent after rework: the only h7-scope.md in the tree tabulates '必红' labels plus a green summary ('1426 passed') with no red-side run transcript on target_base_commit dedbb049 and no per-assertion naming of which assertion was red for cases 2/3/4/5/6/7, so the spec's 判据口径 gate ('先红后绿，红判据必须先跑出红') and §6 item 1 remain unmet — the same gap the prior continuous review rejected.

Mutation echoes (spec §3 cases 8/9, §6 item 2) are still not delivered: tests 8/9 now flip the real guard's state via set_deny_by_default(False)/emptying GOAL_WORKER_ALLOWED_OPS (an improvement over the prior hand-written fake), but no mutated-run echo ('变异回显') exists anywhere in the tree showing case 3 (resp. cases 1/6/7) actually turning red under the mutation.

[RESERVED-PATH REDIRECTED] The required 'production form (direct `python -m katana_work_folder_mcp.server` on 5602, bypassing katana_remote) currently performs no scope judgment' echo is still a prose assertion about module absence at unrelated commit 557e2ed8 — not the target_base dedbb049 — and not a run transcript constructed in the implementer's harness as spec §3 mandates ('该回显由 implementer 在其工装内构造').

R2's gray switch remains a module-level global with a programmatic setter only: no env var, config, or other operator-facing knob exists (no environ/getenv in scope_guard.py; server.py main() reads only HOST/PORT), so the rollback form '改一个开关回 off 即恢复' cannot be executed in the running 5602 service without in-process intervention. Unchanged from the prior review's note; default off, no auto-upgrade, read-face and scopes.py non-goals are respected.
